_about: Template for any other Linux cluster. Copy it, set "prefix", adjust, then run:
python3 install.py --config cfg_generic.json             (build, preferably inside a job)
Keys starting with '_' are comments. Command-line options override this file.
The "machine" entry below is the machine profile (modules, compilers, flags);
its "defaults" set GPU and BLAS. Override them by adding e.g. "gpu": false or
"blas": "mkl" at the top level, or edit the profile. See README.md.
List the modules for GNU compilers, MPI, CMake and Boost under 'modules' (or load
them yourself first and leave it empty). If the defaults of the generic profile
int64 (off with invDFT), petsc (on with invDFT) and elpa_gpu (on with gpu) are
derived automatically. Set "invdft": false to install DFT-FE only.

_notes: Fallback for any Linux cluster. Load your compilers, MPI, CMake and Boost first
(or list them under 'modules'), or copy this file and adapt it for a new machine.
GPU flags come from the installer's built-in CUDA/HIP/SYCL defaults.
machine._modules: e.g. ["gcc/13", "openmpi/5", "cmake", "boost"]; [] = use what is already loaded
machine.description: Any Linux cluster (load your modules first, or pass --modules)

_prefix: REQUIRED: install directory for DFT-FE/invDFT and env.sh; set it here or pass --prefix
_prefix_dependencies: optional: separate install directory for the dependencies (null = same as prefix); set it here or pass --prefix-dependencies
